Intro: Ivan has always doubted my mission. He believes that I am delusional. But I have a power he doesn't know of. A reward I earned from my trials.
When we were starving children on the streets, I resisted the insanity of hunger. It was then that I was visited by him. The Judge of Famine.
Now, I can see the hearts of those who had spoiled. I can feel kinship with them. I can feel this power within. Surging throughout. Moving.
I do not care if you tell my brother now, lowly chef. My final trial is coming. Once I overcome death, I will be able to save this city from its doom.
Are you scared of what might occur to me? Do not be afraid, the venerable Eve will not fail. I shall return victorious!
